articles.title: Configuring an Apex / Root Domain (e.g. yourdomain.com)
articles.problem: How do I configure my apex domain to work with Dub?
articles.solution:
Add an 'A' record in your DNS provider:
• Type: A
• Name / Host: @ (or leave blank if registrar does not allow @)
• Value / Target: 76.76.21.21
• TTL: 86400 (or lowest supported / auto).
Note: Dub automatically redirects www.yourdomain.com to your root apex domain.

articles.title: Configuring a Subdomain (e.g. go.yourdomain.com, links.yourdomain.com)
articles.problem: How do I configure a subdomain on Dub?
articles.solution:
Add a 'CNAME' record in your DNS provider:
• Type: CNAME
• Name / Host: the subdomain prefix (e.g. 'go' for go.yourdomain.com, or 'links')
• Value / Target: cname.dub.co
• TTL: 86400 (or lowest supported / auto).

articles.title: Cloudflare DNS: Grey Cloud (DNS Only) vs Orange Cloud (Proxied)
articles.problem: My links are failing or throwing Error 525 / SSL handshake failed on Cloudflare.
articles.solution:
Root Cause: Cloudflare proxying (Orange Cloud) can interfere with Dub's anycast edge SSL and geo-analytics.
Fix:
1. Recommended: In Cloudflare DNS, set the Proxy status toggle to 'DNS Only' (Grey Cloud).
2. If Orange Cloud is mandatory: You MUST go to Cloudflare Dashboard -> SSL/TLS -> Set encryption mode to 'Full' or 'Full (strict)'. Do NOT use 'Flexible'.

articles.title: SSL Certificate Pending / ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR
articles.problem: My domain says 'Invalid configuration' or browser shows ERR_SSL_PROTOCOL_ERROR.
articles.solution:
1. SSL certificates are provisioned automatically via Let's Encrypt once DNS records resolve.
2. DNS propagation typically takes 5 to 15 minutes, but can take up to 24 hours depending on registrar TTL.
3. Verify your DNS using dig or whatsmydns.net. If pointing to 76.76.21.21 or cname.dub.co, wait 10 minutes and click 'Refresh' in the Dub dashboard.

articles.title: Domain Previously Used on Vercel (Ownership Verification)
articles.problem: Dub error: 'Domain is already in use by another team/project on Vercel'.
articles.solution:
Because Dub's edge routing integrates with Vercel's Anycast infrastructure, you must verify ownership:
1. Add a TXT verification record:
• Type: TXT
• Name: _vercel
• Value: (Copy verification token displayed in your Dub dashboard)
2. Once verified, the previous project mapping will be released.

articles.title: API Rate Limits & 429 Too Many Requests
articles.problem: I received HTTP 429 Too Many Requests when calling Dub API.
articles.solution:
Rate Limit Thresholds (per minute):
• Free Plan: 60 requests/min
• Pro Plan: 600 requests/min
• Business Plan: 1,200 requests/min
• Enterprise / Advanced: 3,000 requests/min

How to handle:
1. Check the 'Retry-After' response header to see exact wait time in seconds.
2. Inspect 'X-RateLimit-Remaining' to track your budget.
3. Implement exponential backoff in your code.
4. For creating multiple links, use the Bulk API ('POST /links/bulk') which processes up to 100 links per request.

articles.title: Creating Links via REST API & SDK
articles.problem: How do I create a short link using Python or TypeScript?
articles.solution:
Endpoint: POST https://api.dub.co/links
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <DUB_API_KEY>

Payload JSON:
{
  "url": "https://yourcompany.com/blog/article",
  "domain": "go.yourdomain.com",
  "key": "spring-sale",
  "tags": ["marketing", "spring"],
  "trackConversion": true
}

Python SDK:
from dub import Dub
client = Dub(token="DUB_API_KEY")
link = client.links.create(request={"url": "https://example.com", "domain": "go.mybrand.com"})
print(link.short_link)

articles.title: HTTP 409 Conflict: Key Already Exists
articles.problem: API returns 409 Conflict when attempting to create a link.
articles.solution:
A link with that exact 'key' (slug) already exists for that domain.
Options:
1. If you want to update the existing link, use 'PUT /links/{linkId}' or 'PATCH /links/{linkId}'.
2. If you want a unique random key, omit the 'key' field in your payload and Dub will generate a clean random 7-character hash.

articles.title: Supported Webhook Events & Global Configuration
articles.problem: Which webhook events does Dub support and how are they configured?
articles.solution:
Supported Events:
• 'link.created': Fired when a new short link is created.
• 'link.updated': Fired when a link's destination URL or metadata changes.
• 'link.deleted': Fired when a link is archived or deleted.
• 'link.clicked': Real-time click stream with geo and device data.

Note: Bulk operations (POST /links/bulk) do NOT trigger individual webhook events to prevent overwhelming downstream receiver servers.

articles.title: Verifying Webhook HMAC SHA-256 Signatures
articles.problem: How do I securely verify that an incoming webhook payload was sent by Dub?
articles.solution:
Dub signs each webhook payload with your webhook secret using HMAC SHA-256.
Header: 'Dub-Signature'

Verification Algorithm (Python):
import hmac, hashlib

def verify_signature(payload_bytes: bytes, signature_header: str, secret: str) -> bool:
    expected_signature = hmac.new(secret.encode('utf-8'), payload_bytes, hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
    return hmac.compare_digest(expected_signature, signature_header)
